supersession_rule: Changes require an explicit Conductor design revision, compatibility analysis, and updated contract tests before implementation.
principles: Rust owns stable shared numerical policy and portable result semantics.
Python is the reference facade and owns orchestration, schemas, ingestion, CLI, plotting, reporting, and optional research integrations.
The C ABI is intentionally narrow and capability-discovered; binding breadth is declared per method rather than inferred from Python.
R and Julia packages must be tested as installed packages and must never depend on an undeclared ambient shared-library path.
JSON Schema is normative for document interchange; Arrow PyCapsule is preferred for in-process columnar interchange with a tested DataFrame-protocol fallback.
Experimental capabilities remain namespaced and cannot enlarge the stable API or ABI without promotion evidence.

owns: language-neutral decision and study domain types

must_not_own: duplicate implementations of promoted stable Rust kernels
eager loading of optional or validation-only dependencies
ambient external-library discovery as the installed default
ambient loader-name dependency as the installed default

stable_api_policy.compatibility_window: At least two minor releases and six months, whichever is longer; removal only in a new major contract.
stable_api_policy.additive_change: May add optional fields, diagnostics, or experimental namespace entries when older consumers can ignore them safely.
stable_api_policy.breaking_change: Requires a new major contract, migration guide, old/new fixtures, and installed-consumer tests.
stable_api_policy.error_policy: Stable diagnostic class and code are cross-language contract; message prose may add context without changing classification.
stable_api_policy.experimental_policy: No top-level stable export, no stable capability bit, and no support claim until promotion gates pass.

decision_problem_target.required_repair: Correct the false industry binding manifest rather than inventing unreviewed cross-language symbols.

c_abi_policy.additive_change: Increment the ABI minor, add a capability bit, retain every prior symbol and layout, and add C, Rust, R, and Julia conformance fixtures.
c_abi_policy.breaking_change: Introduce a new voiage_v2_ namespace; retain v1 for the declared compatibility window.
c_abi_policy.baseline_gate: Compare exported symbols, fixed-width layouts, header declarations, and a built installed consumer against the v2.1.0 release baseline and the candidate.
c_abi_policy.decision_problem: No C ABI in this programme unless a separately reviewed ownership, lifecycle, serialization, and memory-safety design is approved.
prohibited: Rust repr(Rust) layout in the public ABI
borrowed pointers without declared lifetime and length

python.target: Maturin wheels embedding the PyO3 extension for every supported Python/platform tag.
python.installed_gate: Build wheel and sdist, install into clean environments, run public import/API/serialization tests without repository path access.

r.target: A source package with NeedsCompilation: yes that builds and links the pinned minimal Rust FFI into the package DLL from packaged source and an offline Cargo vendor set.
r.system_requirements: Rust and Cargo at or above the repository MSRV for source builds; no undeclared preinstalled voiage shared library.
r.optional_python: reticulate remains Suggests-only for EVPPI and EVSI compatibility methods and is never required for package load, EVPI, or ENBS.
r.installed_gate: Clean source-package install, load, EVPI/ENBS native fixtures, optional reticulate fixtures, examples, vignettes, pkgcheck, coverage, and R CMD check on the supported matrix.

julia.target: A declared Voiage_jll/Artifacts dependency supplies the platform library; VOIAGE_FFI_LIBRARY is a development override only.
julia.repository_prerequisite: Maintain an exact-version BinaryBuilder/Yggdrasil recipe and checksums before Julia registry submission.
julia.external_gate: Voiage_jll recipe merge and artifact publication cannot be claimed from local readiness.
julia.installed_gate: Test a clean package copy with no repository-relative library lookup across Julia 1.10, 1.11, and 1.12 on Linux, macOS, and Windows.

serialization_policy.document_contract: Versioned JSON Schema plus canonical JSON and provenance digests.
serialization_policy.columnar_primary: Arrow PyCapsule interface when a producer supports it.
serialization_policy.columnar_fallback: DataFrame interchange protocol with explicit allow-copy, null, categorical, timezone, and ownership tests.
serialization_policy.legacy_formats: TreeAge, RDS, and Excel support may be claimed only with authoritative fixtures and explicit optional dependencies; otherwise documentation must mark them unsupported or compatibility-only.

installed_artifact_gates: No test may pass solely by matching manifest or workflow strings when it claims a shipped symbol.
Every declared implemented symbol must be resolved and invoked from a clean installed artifact.
Shared numerical fixtures must run through Python wheel, Rust API, C ABI, installed R package, and installed Julia package for every capability each surface declares.
Unsupported capabilities must fail with a documented capability result rather than an ambient loader or missing-symbol accident.
Release evidence must bind package version, source commit, lockfiles, ABI baseline, checksums, SBOM, and provenance to one candidate.
